// # Easing interfaces
//
// The single abstraction the easing catalog is built on: a pure map from
// normalized time to normalized progress. The classic selectors and the
// parameterized easing records that implement it live in `easing.types.plato`.

// A pure easing curve: maps normalized time to normalized progress. Eval(0)
// yields 0 and Eval(1) yields 1; intermediate values may leave [0, 1]
// (overshoot and anticipation).
